battle.name: 基托斯戰爭
battle.theater: 猶太行省與地中海東岸
battle.brief: 115年起，猶太社群在埃及、利比亞、塞浦路斯與美索不達米亞相繼起事，安息戰線抽空了帝國東翼的守備，圖拉真遂以盧西烏斯·奎厄圖斯鎮壓，叛軍退入猶太行省，117年以呂達之圍收場。卡面的羅馬投石機是圍城用的重型扭力投射器，負責拆牆與壓制城頭，正是這條戰線上攻城一方的主幹器械。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 基托斯戰爭（115年—117年）是第二次猶太—羅馬戰爭的一場，也是圖拉真安息遠征釀出來的副產物。交戰的一方是羅馬帝國：皇帝把東翼的野戰主力全部押到亞美尼亞與美索不達米亞，猶太行省只剩駐軍與行省總督，埃及有第二十二德奧塔里亞納軍團，塞浦路斯與利比亞昔蘭尼加只有分遣隊與輔兵，敘利亞行省總督同時管著這幾處的增援調度。另一方是分散在帝國各地的猶太社群：亞歷山卓的猶太人、塞浦路斯的猶太人、美索不達米亞塞琉西亞—泰西封的猶太人，以及最後退入猶太行省山地城鎮的起義者。第三方是同樣被捲進去的希臘與羅馬居民、埃及的鄉村居民、安息帝國，以及塞琉西亞城中被安息人攻破後的居民。名稱本身也是戰史的一部分：希伯來文的「基托斯」出自猶太巴勒斯坦阿拉姆語，是希臘文「基厄圖斯之戰」的訛傳，指的正是鎮壓起義的羅馬將軍盧西烏斯·奎厄圖斯。
countriesEn: The Kitos War (115-117 CE) was one theatre of the Second Jewish-Roman War and a by-product of Trajan's Parthian expedition. One side was the Roman Empire: the emperor had committed the field armies of the eastern provinces to Armenia and Mesopotamia, leaving Judaea with a garrison and a provincial governor, Egypt with Legio XXII Deiotariana, and Cyprus and Cyrenaica in Libya with detachments and auxiliaries only, while the governor of Syria handled the dispatch of reinforcements to all of them at once. The other side was the Jewish communities scattered across the empire: the Jews of Alexandria, the Jews of Cyprus, the Jews of Seleucia and Ctesiphon in Mesopotamia, and finally the insurgents who withdrew into the hill towns of Judaea. Third parties caught in the affair were Greek and Roman residents, the Egyptian countryside, the Parthian Empire, and the inhabitants of Seleucia once the Parthians had stormed the city. The name is itself part of the military history: the Hebrew form derives from Jewish Palestinian Aramaic and is a corruption of the Greek 'War of Quietus', after the Roman general Lusius Quietus who put the revolt down.
people: 這場戰爭留下的人名不多，而且分落在兩端：羅馬一端是皇帝與將軍，猶太一端是起義領袖與拉比。核心人物是盧西烏斯·奎厄圖斯，出身卡帕多細亞，116年奉命平定美索不達米亞的騷動，奪回尼西比斯、攻入埃德薩，117年被圖拉真授為執政官並出任猶太行省總督，戰爭的別名就來自他的名字。皇帝圖拉真本人遠在安息前線，只能靠委任與文書來調度，117年冬天退回安提阿，東翼的局勢就擺在他面前等他決定。馬爾基烏斯·圖爾博原被派去對抗安息人，後來被改派到埃及與利比亞，用極其嚴酷的手段把當地的猶太起義壓了下去。猶太方面的領袖有朱利安與帕普斯兩兄弟、在昔蘭尼加率眾的安德烈阿斯（又作盧庫阿斯）、在塞浦路斯率眾的阿爾特米翁。拉班·迦瑪列二世被困在呂達，他在聖燈節准許守齋的消息，是這場戰爭唯一流傳下來的拉比記載；事後被反覆傳頌的「呂達之死者」則把朱利安與帕普斯列為殉道者。記錄者方面，卡西烏斯·狄奧與優西比烏斯是敘述安息戰線與猶太行省事蹟的兩位主角，希普波利圖斯留下耶路撒冷聖殿山上立起偶像的記錄。哈德良在圖拉真死後接管了殘局：調兵、升格行省，並在118年夏天讓奎厄圖斯消失。
peopleEn: Few personal names survive from this war, and they sit at two ends of it: at the Roman end, an emperor and a general; at the Jewish end, insurgent leaders and rabbis. The central figure is Lusius Quietus, a Cappadocian who was ordered to put down the disturbances in Mesopotamia in 116, retook Nisibis and sacked Edessa, and was granted the consulship and the governorship of Judaea by Trajan in 117; the war takes its alternative name from him. The emperor himself was far away on the Parthian front, able to act only by delegation and written instruction, and he withdrew to Antioch in the winter of 117 with the situation in the east waiting for his decision. Marcius Turbo, originally sent to face the Parthians, was redirected to Egypt and Libya and suppressed the Jewish rising there by extremely harsh means. On the Jewish side the leaders were the brothers Julian and Pappus, Andreas (also called Lukuas) in Cyrenaica, and Artemion in Cyprus. Rabban Gamaliel II was shut up in Lydda, and the permission to fast on Hanukkah that he granted is the only rabbinic account of this war to come down to us; the 'slain of Lydda', praised repeatedly afterwards, lists Julian and Pappus among the martyrs. As recorders, Cassius Dio and Eusebius are the two principal narrators of the Parthian front and of events in Judaea, and Hippolytus records the raising of an idol on the Temple Mount in Jerusalem. Hadrian took over the aftermath on Trajan's death: he moved troops, raised the status of the province, and in the summer of 118 made Quietus disappear.
kits: 卡面是投石機（Onager），羅馬的重型扭力投射器：厚重的木框架埋入土中，拋臂一端絞上蓄能的扭力束，發射時把配重石塊甩向目標。它不是野戰兵器，而是圍城器械，通常架在攻城塔後方或加固的射位上，瞄準的是城牆、塔樓與城門。維特魯威《建築十書》第十卷留下羅馬扭力攻城機的完整描述；約瑟夫斯《猶太戰爭》記載的馬薩達之圍（約73/74年）則證明這種器械在猶太地區確實存在，也證明守方會自製一件同型器械用來反擊。放回基托斯戰爭看，位置很特別：呂達之圍的攻城細節幾乎沒有留下文字，史料只記下結果，但可以確定的是，羅馬圍攻猶太山地的築堡城鎮，用的正是這套標準攻城裝備；同一套工程技術也出現在安息前線，例如圖拉真在哈特拉吃的攻城苦果。羅馬的常備投射器另有手拉與腳踏的弩砲（arcuballista），負責平射速射，與投石機形成高低搭配；撞槌、雲梯、攻城塔與塹壕則把火力集中到城牆的一點上。攻城器材靠牛車與海路輸送，羅馬步兵的裝備是短劍、矩形盾牌與札甲，投槍手與弓箭手在攻城隊形兩翼掩護；猶太起義者用投石索、短刀與弓，靠城垛與巷戰消耗進攻者。
kitsEn: The card shows an onager, the heavy Roman torsion stone-thrower: a massive timber frame sunk into the ground, the throwing arm fitted with a bundle of twisted sinew that stores the energy, and the stone shot flung at the target when the engine is released. It is not a field weapon but a siege engine, normally set up behind a siege tower or in a reinforced firing position and aimed at walls, towers and gates. Vitruvius' De architectura, book ten, preserves a full description of the Roman torsion siege engines; Josephus' Jewish War, in its account of the siege of Masada (about 73/74 CE), proves that the machine existed in Judaea and that the defenders built a counterpart of their own to answer it. Placed back in the Kitos War, its position is peculiar: almost no text describes the siege of Lydda, and the sources record only the outcome, but what is certain is that the Roman circumvallation of the fortified hill towns of Judaea used precisely this standard siege equipment, and that the same engineering technology also appeared on the Parthian front, as in the bitter siege Trajan fought at Hatra. The standing Roman missile artillery included the hand- and foot-operated arcuballista for flatter and faster shooting, complementing the onager's heavier work; battering rams, scaling ladders, siege towers and covered approaches concentrated the fire on one point of the wall. The siege train was moved by ox-carts and by sea, while the Roman infantry carried the short sword, the rectangular shield and segmented armour, with javelin-men and archers covering the flanks of the assault column. The Jewish insurgents used slings, short swords and bows, and relied on parapets and street fighting to wear down the attackers.
tactics: 可用的戰術資料大半來自羅馬圍城的標準做法，史料本身對基托斯戰爭的戰鬥過程幾乎不置一詞。起義者的做法是遊擊式的破壞與據守：襲擊鄉村與驛站，切斷道路，把主力收攏在有城牆的山地聚落與聖地城市裡；羅馬縱隊一進入狹窄谷地，就從兩側高地上以投石索與弓箭襲擊，之後退回城中。守城依靠城牆、角樓與加固的城門，並設法騷擾攻城塔與射位。羅馬這邊是圍城與掃蕩並行：分遣隊沿大道推進，逐個清剿小型據點，遇到有抵抗的築堡城鎮便合圍，用投射器壓制城頭火力、以攻城塔貼近，再用撞槌開門；同時以騎兵巡邏切斷城鄉之間的聯絡，並用海路把補充兵員與攻城器材直接送到地中海沿岸的基地。東線方面，圖拉真從安息前線抽調分遣隊，寫在執政官級將領的指揮下同時壓向幾個方向，這正是多地同時起事卻迅速被各個擊破的關鍵。安息前線本身也用同一套羅馬工程術：圖拉真在哈特拉的攻城因器械不足與守方工事而失敗，最後改用封鎖斷糧，那已經是羅馬圍城術在這條戰線上的極限。
tacticsEn: Most of the usable tactical material comes from the standard Roman practice of siege warfare, for the sources themselves say almost nothing about how the fighting in the Kitos War actually went. The insurgents worked by harassment and by holding ground: raiding villages and posting stations, cutting roads, and concentrating their strength in walled hill settlements and in the cities of the sanctuaries; when a Roman column entered a narrow valley they would strike it from the heights on either side with slings and arrows, then fall back inside the walls. The defence relied on the wall, on corner towers and on reinforced gates, and on interfering with the siege towers and firing positions. On the Roman side the business of the campaign was siege and sweep in parallel: detachments advanced along the main roads, clearing small strongpoints one by one; where a fortified town held out, they surrounded it, used the artillery to silence the defenders on the wall, brought the siege towers up against the masonry, and then opened the gates with the ram; cavalry patrols cut the roads between town and country, and reinforcements and siege stores were brought by sea straight to the ports along the Mediterranean. In the east, Trajan stripped vexillations off the Parthian front and drove them at several axes at once under consular commanders, which is the key to understanding how simultaneous risings in many places could be beaten separately and quickly. The Parthian front itself ran on the same Roman engineering: Trajan's siege of Hatra failed for want of engines and because of the defenders' works, and he fell back on blockade and famine, which was the limit of Roman siegecraft on this front.
data: 數字要分成可靠與不可靠兩堆。時間是比較可靠的一堆：起事自115年開始，116年夏擴散到美索不達米亞，117年在猶太行省收束，118年初埃及仍有零星動盪；塔木德把這場戰爭放在大戰（66/70年）之後52年、對巴科巴起義之前16年，也就是117年。地理距離也大致可推：亞歷山卓到耶路撒冷陸路約四百多公里，塞浦路斯到迦薩走海路超過八百公里，昔蘭尼加與美索不達米亞更在千里之外，起義者要靠海路與商隊才能把消息與人送回猶太。羅馬方面的建制有名字可指：駐猶太的第十弗里提西斯軍團、留下耶路撒冷神壇銘文的第三基雷奈卡軍團、哈德良調往凱撒提亞的第六費拉塔軍團、駐埃及的第二十二德奧塔里亞納軍團，約在120年再加駐第二圖拉真軍團；遠征安息還牽走大量分遣隊。不可靠的一堆是傷亡：沒有任何一份編年留下雙方陣亡數字。塔木德《安息日》與《阿伏達臘》提到「基托斯之戰」年羅馬方面折損二十萬，這是宗教文學傳統的數字，學者多視為象徵性的誇大，不能當作編年事實。唯一被反覆引用的具體人數，是呂達陷落後被處決者與殉道者的名單殘段，仍不足以推算全役規模。
dataEn: Numbers have to be split into a reliable pile and an unreliable one. Chronology is the more reliable pile: the rising began in 115, spread to Mesopotamia in the summer of 116, closed up in Judaea in 117, and Egypt was still showing sporadic unrest in early 118; the Talmud places the war fifty-two years after the Great War (66/70 CE) and sixteen years before the Bar Kokhba revolt, that is, in 117. Distances can be roughly reconstructed: about four hundred and more kilometres overland from Alexandria to Jerusalem, more than eight hundred kilometres by sea from Cyprus to Gaza, with Cyrenaica and Mesopotamia thousands of kilometres further away, so that the insurgents could only get news and men back to Judaea by sea and by caravan. On the Roman side the order of battle can be named rather than numbered: Legio X Fretensis in Judaea, Legio III Cyrenaica, whose altar inscription survives in Jerusalem, Legio VI Ferrata, which Hadrian moved to Caesarea, and Legio XXII Deiotariana in Egypt, with a second legion, probably Legio II Traiana, added by about 120; the Parthian expedition had also drawn away a great many vexillations. The unreliable pile is the casualty figures: no chronicle preserves a number for either side. The Talmud in Yoma and Avodah Zarah mentions that in the year of the war of Kitos two hundred thousand of the Romans fell, a figure from religious literature that scholars generally treat as symbolic exaggeration rather than as an annalistic fact. The only specific figures repeatedly cited are the scraps of the list of those executed and martyred after Lydda fell, and they are still not enough to size the whole war.
cause: 起事有遠因，也有直接的導火線。遠因是70年耶路撒冷第二聖殿被毀之後留下的創傷：猶太人失去國家的宗教中心，羅馬對猶太身份的觀感轉為懷疑，聖殿崇拜被禁，捐稅與地方稅負加重，彌賽亞與救贖的期待在高壓之下累積。第二層是結構性的：安息統治下的美索不達米亞猶太社群享有相對受保障的地位，羅馬接管之後既要納稅又要受軍官歧視，兩種統治的落差本身就是燃料。直接導火線是圖拉真的安息遠征：114年之後帝國東翼主力全部投入亞美尼亞與美索不達米亞戰線，猶太行省、埃及與塞浦路斯只剩守備兵力，鎮壓的窗口被打開。第三層是各地既有的摩擦同時爆發：亞歷山卓的希臘與猶太社群衝突、塞浦路斯希臘城鎮與猶太人的對立、昔蘭尼加的城鄉對抗，幾乎在同一時間互相示範。宗教上的挑釁同樣要緊：銘文顯示116年駐軍在耶路撒冷聖殿山立起塞拉庇斯神壇，希普波利圖斯記載有軍團立起科瑞女神像，這類行為足以讓任何起義拿到號召的旗幟。
causeEn: There were distant causes and a proximate trigger. The distant cause was the wound left by the destruction of the Second Temple in Jerusalem in 70 CE: the Jews lost the religious centre of their nation, Roman opinion of the legitimacy of Jewish identity hardened into suspicion, the cult of the Temple was forbidden, taxes and local levies grew heavier, and messianic hopes of redemption accumulated under pressure. The second layer was structural: the Jewish communities of Mesopotamia enjoyed comparatively protected status under Parthian rule, and after the Roman takeover they had to pay taxes and endure the arrogance of Roman officers, and that contrast between two rulers was itself fuel. The proximate trigger was Trajan's Parthian expedition: after 114 the main body of the eastern armies was committed to Armenia and Mesopotamia, Judaea, Egypt and Cyprus were left with garrison troops only, and the window for repression was thrown open. The third layer is the way that existing friction in several provinces broke out at once: the clash between Greek and Jewish communities in Alexandria, the antagonism between the Greek towns of Cyprus and the island's Jews, the town-and-country antagonism of Cyrenaica, each of which served as a demonstration to the others. Religious provocation mattered too: an inscription shows a garrison raising an altar to Serapis on the Temple Mount in Jerusalem in 116, and Hippolytus records a legion setting up an image of the goddess Kore, and acts of that kind gave any rising a banner to rally behind.
impact: 戰後的羅馬東部秩序被重排了一次。猶太行省由行省總督級別升為執政官級行省，約120年加駐第二個軍團，哈德良把第六費拉塔軍團永久調到凱撒提亞，第十弗里提西斯留在耶路撒冷，再加上沿線的輔兵與艦隊，猶太行省第一次長期以常駐軍團的姿態出現。帝國邊界也定了下來：哈德良放棄美索不達米亞行省，把奧斯羅伊尼交給帕爾塔馬斯帕特斯，兩國之間維持約一世紀的緩衝。猶太方面的代價極大：亞歷山卓、昔蘭尼加與塞浦路斯的猶太社群被清剿到幾近滅絕，考古層面在昔蘭尼加看到需要重建的破壞痕跡；美索不達米亞的猶太人在安息人攻陷塞琉西亞時先遭屠殺，之後又被羅馬當成通敵者清除，魯克米尼編年史記下了這一段。拉比傳統把「基托斯之戰」記成一場羅馬重創的失敗戰役，朱利安與帕普斯列為殉道者，這段記憶日後被拿來對照巴科巴起義，說明這場戰爭的歷史形象是在事後才被塑造的。史學上最有趣的一點是名字：戰爭叫「基托斯」，指的卻是奎厄圖斯，一個名字被訛傳的人；戰爭本身留下的直接記載稀少，學者只能靠狄奧、優西比烏斯、塔木德與銘文拼湊出輪廓。118年夏天奎厄圖斯被除掉、哈德良放棄東方政策，讓這場戰爭成了圖拉真時代的收場音符。
impactEn: The Roman order in the east was rearranged afterwards. Judaea was raised from a praetorian province to a consular province, a second legion was added by about 120, Hadrian moved Legio VI Ferrata permanently to Caesarea Maritima, Legio X Fretensis stayed at Jerusalem, and with the auxiliaries and the fleet on the coast the province now appeared for the first time with a permanent legionary garrison. The frontier of the empire was settled as well: Hadrian abandoned the province of Mesopotamia and handed Osroene to Parthamaspates, and the two powers faced each other across roughly a century of buffer peace. The cost on the Jewish side was enormous: the Jewish communities of Alexandria, Cyrenaica and Cyprus were hunted down almost to extermination, and the archaeological layers at Cyrene show destruction that had to be rebuilt; the Jews of Mesopotamia were first slaughtered when the Parthians stormed Seleucia and then cleared out by the Romans as suspected collaborators, a passage preserved in the Chronicle of Ruqmini. Rabbinic tradition remembered the 'war of Kitos' as a defeat that had cost Rome dearly and listed Julian and Pappus among the martyrs, and that memory was later set against the Bar Kokhba revolt, which shows that the historical shape of this war was shaped only afterwards. The most telling point for historians is the name: the war is called 'Kitos' but refers to Quietus, a man whose name was corrupted; the direct record of the war itself is thin, and scholars have to assemble its outline from Dio, Eusebius, the Talmud and the inscriptions. Quietus's removal in the summer of 118 and Hadrian's abandonment of the eastern policy made this war the closing note of the Trajanic age.
result: 結果是起義方被各個擊破。116年夏，美索不達米亞的騷動由奎厄圖斯平定，他奪回尼西比斯、攻入埃德薩；116年至117年間，馬爾基烏斯·圖爾博在埃及與利比亞以極端手段鎮壓起義，希臘與羅馬居民組成的地方武裝配合拉丁軍團，把昔蘭尼加與塞浦路斯的猶太武裝清除，埃及方面還有圍攻亞歷山卓的戰役。117年，猶太行省的抵抗在呂達收場：城破之後大量起義者被處決，朱利安與帕普斯殉道，拉比文獻稱之為「呂達之死者」。到117年底，帝國東部的起義大致平定，118年初埃及仍有零星騷動。此後的走向卻對勝方不利：118年夏天，剛立下戰功的奎厄圖斯被除掉，命令很可能出自哈德良；哈德良放棄美索不達米亞，遣回安息王子執掌奧斯羅伊尼，暫停圖拉真的東征。猶太行省表面恢復秩序，然而十餘年後，哈德良在130年到訪，決定重建耶路撒冷為艾利亞卡比托利納，卻把新的火種埋下；132年爆發的巴科巴起義把猶太—羅馬戰爭推向最後的高潮。
resultEn: The result was that the insurgents were beaten piecemeal. In the summer of 116 Quietus settled the disturbances in Mesopotamia, retaking Nisibis and sacking Edessa; between 116 and 117 Marcius Turbo crushed the risings in Egypt and Libya by extremely harsh means, and local forces of Greek and Roman residents worked together with the Latin legions to clear the Jewish armed bands out of Cyrenaica and Cyprus, and in Egypt there was also a siege of Alexandria. In 117 the resistance in Judaea ended at Lydda: after the city fell, a large number of the insurgents were executed, Julian and Pappus died as martyrs, and the rabbinic literature calls them 'the slain of Lydda'. By the end of 117 the risings in the eastern empire had largely been put down, though Egypt still saw sporadic trouble in early 118. What followed, however, was unfavourable to the victors: in the summer of 118 Quietus, freshly credited with crushing the revolt, was put to death on orders that may well have come from Hadrian; Hadrian abandoned Mesopotamia, sent an Arsacid prince to rule Osroene, and halted Trajan's eastward conquests. Order was superficially restored in Judaea, but a little over a decade later Hadrian visited the province in 130 and decided to rebuild Jerusalem as Aelia Capitolina, planting the seed of a new fire; when the Bar Kokhba revolt broke out in 132 it carried the Jewish-Roman wars to their final climax.
